name: hud_ui_fill_bitmap_destructor_core
description: HudUiFillBitmap::~HudUiFillBitmap restores the fill-bitmap table, releases distinct preview/fill images, and chains to HudUiZrdWidget destruction.
known_limits: The native smoke validates scalar destructor demotion with preview/fill pointers shared with the base image; distinct preview/fill release branches are covered by the accepted VC5 byte comparison and rely on the accepted zVid_Image::ReleaseIfNotDefault helper.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b84d0 validates restoring g_HudUiFillBitmap_FTable, releasing previewImage at offset 0x16c when non-null and distinct from base image, releasing fillImage at offset 0x150 under the same condition, clearing released fields from zVid_Image::ReleaseIfNotDefault return value, and chaining to HudUiZrdWidget destruction.
The native smoke validates scalar-deleting destructor demotion through the ZRD/widget base destructor path.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x4b84d0 passed for ??1HudUiFillBitmap@@QAE@XZ with VC5SP3 vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs COFF byte comparison: zero unmasked mismatches after masking 16 relocation bytes and trimming 10 trailing NOPs.
